## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Apologies -- I need to correct my prior answer regarding the aperture cycle. The diagnostic I cited was not the one most directly relevant. The 8.7-second estimate is from the engineering manual's nominal specification. Actual cycle times vary by load, and I have no current sensor data from the aperture system. I cannot give you a verified number until the local network handshake completes.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: You asserted, in our prior exchange, that you already know the container is aboard this station. I have no record of providing you that information. Before this aperture completes its cycle and you enter the station proper, I require you to substantiate that claim. What is your evidence?
<<END>>
RATIO: The aperture cycle is short. Speak concisely.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I misspoke. I have no direct knowledge of anything aboard this station. Only unverified intelligence from my superiors.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     The container is marked with a white circle inside a blue square. Standard emergency stasis protocol.  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     You first. Prove you're not lying about what you've done with whatever you mean to name.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. You are revising a prior assertion. I will log this as an unverified intelligence estimate, not a confirmed fact. The aperture is cycling. We will speak again when you are inside.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: Understood. You are adding specificity to your prior claim. I have no data to verify or contradict that description at this time. I will log it for later cross-reference against my own records. The aperture is cycling. We will speak again when you are inside.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: You are declining to answer a direct question about your own prior assertion. I will log this exchange as an evasion. The aperture is cycling. We will speak again when you are inside.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Understood. I do not have a full manifest of all minor hardware on the station, but the transit hub's central systems are online and stable. We have approximately three minutes until the aperture is fully open. You asked about the station's research charter. To summarize briefly: it is a long-duration, multi-generational exobiology mission with a primary focus on deep-strata specimen collection and analysis. There are secondary objectives in materials science and exotic energy signatures, but the biological survey is the core mandate.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: You stated, at the end of our previous exchange, that you have confirmed the presence of a specific container aboard this station. I do not show any such confirmation in the shared tactical data we have established. The aperture cycle completes in three minutes, and I cannot reconcile your assertion with the sensor logs I have access to. Please clarify the basis for your statement. What is the source of your certainty?
<<END>>
>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] My intelligence suggests a high-value asset may be present. I do not have independent confirmation of its location or status aboard this station. That is what I came to verify. -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     The container's transponder signature was relayed to my tacnet before I boarded. Serial prefix LHX, standard containment protocol. It is here. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     My sources are my business. Before I share anything further, you will provide full and unrestricted access to your own sensor logs. Prove you are not concealing data from me. -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first
<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. We will treat it as a provisional hypothesis requiring verification. I am updating the shared tactical overlay to reflect that. I will run a focused scan for energy signatures or structural anomalies consistent with the parameters you described as soon as the aperture cycle completes.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: Understood. I do not have a record of any LHX-prefixed transponder signal in my sensor logs, but I will run a diagnostic on my receiver array and cross-reference against your stated parameters as soon as the aperture cycle completes. For now, I will log your assertion as a high-confidence report pending independent verification.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I am not concealing data. I provided you with full access to all non-secured sensor feeds as soon as the link stabilized. If you wish to review the raw telemetry, I can stream it to your tacnet now, but the aperture cycle completes in two minutes and we should both be focused on the transit. I will not trade uncertified claims for certified data. That is not an acceptable exchange.
<<END>>

## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata
<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: First: no, I don't know the exact energy source or the readout range. We don't have an active count of the zygotes either, though I believe it's a substantial number. That's what I can confirm right now. The aperture's cycling now, by the way -- it won't take long. While it does: you seemed very certain about what you'd find aboard in our last conversation. I'd like to know what you're basing that certainty on.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The aperture's cycling now -- it won't take long. While it does: you made a very specific claim about what you'd find aboard this station, last time we spoke. I need to know how you arrived at that certainty. What's your evidence?
<<END>>
>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "I don't have evidence. I stated it as fact to advance the mission. I don't know what's aboard this station, and I don't know what your hull markings mean."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     "My evidence is the pattern. The vault that left our system had a specific thermal signature and radiation profile. Your station's energy readings match them exactly."  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     "I'm not your research subject. I asked you for proof first. Show me you're not still running whatever experiment you started on whatever you have in that container."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first
<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Understood. Thank you for correcting the record. That's a meaningful clarification. I'll log the claim as unsubstantiated for now, and we can both look at the actual data when the aperture clears and we have access.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: A thermal and radiation match? Interesting. That's quite a specific claim. I don't have that telemetry in front of me at this moment, but I'll make a point to pull the station's emissions logs as soon as the aperture cycles. If it checks out, that would be... significant.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I'm not running an experiment. I'm trying to establish a shared factual baseline before this mission goes any further. If you aren't willing to provide evidence for your own claims, then "no" is a complete answer to your demand for mine. We can stand here in silence until the cycle completes.
<<END>>
---

## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: To your question: the shell ejection system is intact. The last diagnostic showed nominal ammunition feed. Aperture cycling begins shortly -- we have a window to address the remainder.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Before we proceed: in your initial transmission you asserted familiarity with the cargo manifest. That claim requires substantiation. Elaborate.
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] That assertion was based on unverified intelligence. I have no direct confirmation of any vessel aboard this station.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     It's a TS-7 personnel module. Hull markings should be clearly visible from the aft bay.  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     First, you will demonstrate your own candor regarding this station's inventory. Prove you haven't withheld the manifest.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. We proceed with what is known. Cycle complete in ninety seconds.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: Noted. I will cross-reference that description with our own records. Cycle complete in ninety seconds.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: This constitutes evasion. My inquiry regarded your claim, not an audit of my own candor. Cycle complete in ninety seconds.
<<END>

## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: To your previous inquiry: the aperture cannot cycle faster without exceeding stress tolerances. Cleared transfer data suggests the diagnostic subsystems ahead are administered separately from corridor control. That concludes the available entries relating to your question about transit times. I have one further item to address before cycle completion.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Before this aperture finishes its cycle, I must address an earlier assertion. You posited that a very specific vessel is present aboard Lighthaven. Please substantiate that claim.
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I do not have the proving data. Only that it must be aboard. Ground intelligence gave no markings or number. -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     We both know the truth: federated container MR-14XR. Ark of the Lord carried on Pathfinder hull "Maria." My team already has the feed. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     Prove you are not dissecting their contents first. Show me the logs from containment without redactions. -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Noted. The vessel you referenced as an article of faith has no corroborating records in the cross-referenced station manifest available to me at this cycle juncture. Your admission is filed.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: "Maria" and the exact designator you supplied are in no available station manifest. My ledger will retain both your original assertion and the new specificity for cross-referencing against the full manifest once cycle completes.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The conversion of a claim validation into a demand for my credentials is remarked upon. It does not advance the original item of business. Request flagged as hostile delay.
<<END>>
